answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The garden edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 150 clones produces a signature the harbor analysis flags immediately. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the pigment settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
